# VINR Documentation
# https://vinr.com/docs

# Machine-readable documentation index for AI agents
# See: https://llmstxt.org/

## Docs

- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started): Quick start guides, authentication, and test environment setup
- [Integration](/docs/integration): SDKs, webhooks, error handling, and integration patterns
- [Payments](/docs/payments): Payment methods, flows, lifecycle, refunds, and recurring payments
- [Compliance](/docs/compliance): KYC, AML, PCI DSS, GDPR, and regulatory requirements
- [Operations](/docs/operations): Settlement, reconciliation, monitoring, and dashboard guides
- [API Reference](/docs/api-reference): Complete REST API documentation with examples
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues, error codes, and debugging guides

## AI Assistant

- [Ask VINR](/ask): AI-powered conversational assistant for instant documentation answers
